chapter: Wider talk: bands, places and players
title: Meeting Armand Hug at the Fern Cafe
summary: He first heard Armand Hug downstairs at the Fern while upstairs with Johnny, and later the hotel jobs around 1949-51.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: What about Armand, Hug? When did you first meet him?

Well, he used to, uh, when I was, uh, with Johnny, we, we played up, up, up, up, upstairs. I can't think of the name of the dance hall upstairs. And, uh, that was right on the corner of, uh, of the Gundy and Canal Street, right upstairs. You know, a crest that was in between and so forth. But it was, this was on, on, on the, on the Ramport Street side, right in that corner.
I know it wasn't the Fern or the Alamo, uh, maybe, I don't know.

Well, anyway. That was, so, but the Fern was downstairs and that's where Armand, Hug was playing. Mm-hmm. What I was saying, on my animation, I used to go downstairs and, and listen to those guys, you know. And, uh, listen to the different guys. I, I used to, I like to go in and hear this guy, that guy, see? On my animation, or something like that. But that's when I first, uh, right, and then later on, when I come back down, down from, uh, Jimmy, he was playing at, uh, what was his name of that hotel? When? When? Well, there was a Pontchartrain and the Wohl and... I don't know, somewhere else on Bourbon Street, big hotel. Holiday Inn or something like that, no, no. I don't remember that. I don't remember that. So many places. This, this, this is, this is back in, in 51, somewhere around 49, 51.
Prince Conta at one time, he was there.
